import re

PATTERNS = [
    "node_modules",
    "**/*.log",
    ".git",
    "dist",
    "!dist/keep.txt",
    "*.md",
    "coverage/",
]


def translate(pat):
    """把一条 .dockerignore 规则翻译成正则。约定：
    - 无 `/` 的规则匹配任意层级的同名文件/目录（等价 `**/pat`）；
    - `**` 跨目录，`*` 不跨目录，`?` 单字符；
    - 以 `/` 结尾表示只看目录。"""
    p = pat.rstrip("/")
    if "/" not in p:
        p = "**/" + p
    if p.startswith("/"):
        p = p[1:]
    out, i = "", 0
    while i < len(p):
        c = p[i]
        if c == "*":
            if i + 1 < len(p) and p[i + 1] == "*":
                out += ".*"
                i += 2
                if i < len(p) and p[i] == "/":
                    i += 1
                continue
            out += "[^/]*"
        elif c == "?":
            out += "[^/]"
        else:
            out += re.escape(c)
        i += 1
    return re.compile("^" + out + "(?:/.*)?$")


RULES = [(_p.lstrip("!"), translate(_p.lstrip("!")), _p.startswith("!")) for _p in PATTERNS]

FILES = [
    "package.json",
    "src/index.js",
    "src/deep/nested/app.js",
    "node_modules/left-pad/index.js",
    "logs/app.log",
    "logs/2026/app.log",
    ".git/HEAD",
    "dist/bundle.js",
    "dist/keep.txt",
    "README.md",
    "coverage/lcov.info",
]


def ignored(path):
    state = False
    for _, rx, neg in RULES:
        if rx.match(path):
            state = not neg
    return state


print("patterns=%s" % " ".join(PATTERNS))
excluded, kept = [], []
for f in FILES:
    (excluded if ignored(f) else kept).append(f)
print("=== excluded (%d) ===" % len(excluded))
for f in excluded:
    print("  - " + f)
print("=== kept (%d) ===" % len(kept))
for f in kept:
    print("  + " + f)
print("=== judgement ===")
print("negation_keeps_dist_keep_txt=%s" % ("dist/keep.txt" in kept))
print("bare_name_matches_any_depth=%s" % (ignored("src/deep/node_modules/x.js")))
print("doublestar_log_matches_any_depth=%s" % (ignored("logs/2026/app.log")))
print("star_does_not_cross_slash=%s" % (translate("src/*.js").match("src/deep/app.js") is None))
print("star_matches_single_segment=%s" % (translate("src/*.js").match("src/app.js") is not None))
print("bare_star_md_matches_any_depth=%s" % ignored("src/readme.md"))
print("excluded_count=%d kept_count=%d" % (len(excluded), len(kept)))
